name: Reasoning Shell - Experimental Branch
actions: start a gated shell-on or shell-off session
request one gated model step or continue in manual mode
record a gated human checkpoint with a required rejection reason
create and persist a gated after-action record
create a gated proposal-only profile tweak
compare one shell-on and one shell-off export locally
summary: Run profile-guided or comparison-baseline single-step sessions with human checkpoints, fail-closed rejection routes, gated proposal-only after-actions, explicit export, and local count comparisons.
notes: Branch only; not CANON or Foundation. Manual mode remains available without an AI connector. Count comparisons do not prove model quality, learning improvement, or profile effectiveness. Real-model and human-fatigue evidence remains UNKNOWN.
